title: 공항에서의 귀빈 예우에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:9:0:00009:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 9 (Prohibition of Access to Immigration Inspection Areas)
(1) No person other than a user of a VIP lounge and a proxy handler of immigration procedures may enter an immigration inspection area: Provided, That this shall not apply where a protocol event is held in the immigration inspection area.
(2) The head of the regional aviation office shall issue a temporary access pass to a proxy handler of immigration procedures so that he or she may enter the immigration examination area and bonded area. In such cases, prior consultation shall be made with the head of the immigration control office and the head of the customs office.
